items.title: Sprite (character or object, needs a transparent background)
items.when: A single character, creature, prop, or pickup that will be placed and keyed out over other content.
items.template: game sprite of <description>, single character/object, full body visible, centered,
items.suffix: , on a solid uniform bright <KEY COLOR> background, no shadows cast on the background, no ground plane, nothing cropped at the edges

items.title: Tile (repeating surface, pre-seamless-pipeline)
items.when: A repeating ground, wall, floor, or pattern surface that will tile across an area.
items.template: seamless tileable game texture tile of <description>, uniform pattern density,
items.suffix: , perfectly seamless edges that wrap horizontally and vertically, no border, no vignette, flat even lighting, no single focal object
items.note: Treat this output as raw material for flowmo-seamless-texture, not a finished tile - even a strong result here usually still needs the seam-fix pass.

items.title: Background (full-frame establishing shot)
items.when: A wide non-repeating backdrop behind foreground elements.
items.template: game background of <description>, wide establishing view,
items.suffix: , no characters, no UI elements, slightly muted detail so foreground game elements stay readable, soft depth layering

items.title: Texture (flat surface material, e.g. for a 3D surface or PBR source)
items.when: A flat, non-perspective material reference intended as the source for a seamless/PBR pipeline.
items.suffix: , perfectly seamless edges, flat even lighting, no perspective, no objects, photographed-flat appearance
items.note: Same downstream note as tile: hand the result to flowmo-seamless-texture for the seam-fix and PBR-map pass.

items.title: UI element (button, icon, badge; needs a transparent background)
items.when: A single interface element that will be placed over other UI, not a full screen.
items.template: game UI element: <description>, single element, centered,
items.suffix: , on a solid uniform bright <KEY COLOR> background, crisp edges, no drop shadow outside the element
